objective: 以 V3 为行为基线，在 v4/ 内建立更高工程质量的 RouteCodex 基础框架：明确职责分离、物理分离数据面与控制面、提高性能、减少重复代码、固化流程和配置，并将 provider 差异收敛为配置与 action 算子。

boundary.payload_control_separation: confirmed: control resources never enter business request/response/provider payload

acceptance_criteria: V4 can run appsdk verify independently.
No V3 runtime behavior or source is modified by the V4 foundation work.
V3 reuse candidates are recorded with owner, dependency, test coverage and reuse decision.
V4 has explicit data/control plane boundaries and typed stage contracts.
Shared semantics have one owner and provider differences are represented by configuration or action operators.
All new V4 source, experiments, contracts, artifacts and history remain under v4/.
Each future module uses clarify -> Playground -> evidence -> compile -> Active -> Protected lifecycle.
non_goals: Do not change V3 runtime in this phase.
Do not perform live traffic cutover.
Do not copy V3 implementation into V4 without an audit decision.
Do not add provider-specific branches to the V4 core pipeline.
Do not create V4 implementation files under v3/, src/ or sharedmodule/.
assumptions: V3 remains the behavioral compatibility baseline during the migration period.
V4 runtime entry and release wiring are designed separately after the foundation contracts are verified.
Provider-specific behavior can be expressed as validated configuration and action operators without leaking into core pipeline semantics.
